## 3. The stages

| Stage | Dates | What we do | What the defense sees |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quiet gathering | Now to 9 Dec | Obtain certified copies in our own name (Part 4). File nothing in court. | Nothing |
| Our remaining dates | 4 Nov, 11 Nov, 2 Dec | De Leon, King, de los Reyes on their filed affidavits. | What they already have |
| Offer and rest | 9 Dec | Formal offer of the pre-marked exhibits; complete E and H; rest _subject to rebuttal_; ask for rebuttal dates and memoranda. | Our exhibits A to Q, completed |
| Possible demurrer | After 9 Dec | Oppose on the pre-marked record. If it is denied, they must present evidence. If it is granted and reversed on appeal, they lose the right to present evidence (Rule 33 §1). | Nothing new |
| Their case: lock-in | 13 Jan to 10 Mar 2027 | Witnesses affirm their affidavits. On cross: commit them, close the exits, and confront them only with their own exhibits and our marked ones. Order every transcript. | Their own papers only |
| Spring | Rebuttal, after 10 Mar 2027 | File Patricia's affidavit and any subpoenas, keyed to the transcript lines. Offer the certified records as public documents, each answering a sworn claim. | Everything, too late to amend |
| Memoranda | About May 2027 | Decision table: rule, exhibit page, fact, disposition. | — |
